tools.name: list_editorials
tools.title: List editorials
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved editorial studies (newest first), with title, theme, tone and date. Optionally filter by a search term.

search.description: Optional text to match against editorial titles.

limit.description: Maximum number of editorials to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_editorial
tools.title: Get editorial study
tools.description: Fetch one saved editorial study by id, including its summary, structured analysis (issue, causes, effects, solutions), takeaways, SBI PO notes and quiz stats.

id.description: The editorial id returned by list_editorials.

include_full_text.description: Include the full pasted editorial text (default false).

tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.title: Get vocabulary
tools.description: Get vocabulary words (word, part of speech, Hindi and English meaning, synonyms, usage) from the user's saved editorials. Give an editorial id for one study, or omit it to pull recent words across studies.

editorial_id.description: Editorial id to pull vocabulary from.

limit.description: How many recent editorials to pull from when no id is given (default 5).

tools.name: get_quiz_questions
tools.title: Get quiz questions
tools.description: Get the practice questions (RC, vocabulary, cloze, error detection, one-word substitution) generated for a saved editorial, with options, answers and explanations.

type.description: Filter to a single question type.

tools.name: get_study_stats
tools.title: Get study stats
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's overall preparation progress: editorials studied, vocabulary words learned, quizzes attempted and average quiz accuracy.
